title: Snatch and Swing
source: Engine-ready authored setup/solution for this pass; canonical A01 solution is in canon_reference. No decoded GBA fixed-board table was available when this script was authored.
notes: Snatch Steal takes the only opposing monster, clearing the field for Red-Eyes.

canon_reference.setup_status: unknown in A01; this pass ships an engine-ready authored setup
solution_steps: Summon Marauding Captain and use his effect to Special Summon Granadora.
Use Ultra Evolution Pill, select Granadora as the sacrifice and Dark Driceratops as the monster to be summoned.
Attack Gravekeeper's Spy with your Marauding Captain.
Attack The Portrait's Secret with Dark Driceratops.
